name: ask-user-more
description: AskUserMore — richer multiple-choice questions for Claude Code: notes, more than four options, and multi-question rounds.

enabled.title: Enable AskUserMore
enabled.description: Allow this harness to use AskUserMore. Turning this off hides the tool until you re-enable it.

force.title: Replace AskUserQuestion
force.description: Block Claude's built-in AskUserQuestion and route questions to AskUserMore. Turn this off to keep the built-in.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto picks the terminal TUI in terminal hosts and a native form in GUI hosts. Override with elicitation, terminal, or web.

warnOptionsAt.title: Warn at options
warnOptionsAt.description: Warn when one question has this many options. 0 disables the warning.

warnQuestionsAt.title: Warn at questions
warnQuestionsAt.description: Warn when one call has this many questions. 0 disables the warning.

multiStyle.title: Multi-select style
multiStyle.description: array uses native multi-select. booleans uses one checkbox per option for clients without array support.
